prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 9:16 extreme circular-fisheye night street-fashion snapshot of an adult streetwear enthusiast. She has spiky space buns with colored tips and small tooth rhinestone accents, wearing baggy denim shorts, an oversized unbranded vintage-style sports jersey, white socks, and chunky skate shoes. She sits in a low relaxed curb squat outside an unbranded glowing corner shop, eats noodles with chopsticks, and holds an unbranded noodle cup toward the lens. Include wet asphalt reflecting abstract green and red storefront light and a skateboard beside the curb. Use direct flash plus neon spill, a curved horizon, strong perspective, circular vignette, subtle chromatic aberration, raw grain, and no readable signage or logos.
